title: Deaths among patients placed in forensic psychiatric care pursuant to Section 63 of the German Criminal Code (StGB) – An analysis of risk factors, care structures, and prevention options
summary: The aim of the study is to systematically analyze deaths in forensic hospitals from a medical and forensic perspective. Among other things, it will examine the contrast and differences between predictable or expected deaths and sudden, unpredictable deaths. In addition, it will identify any structural deficits that hinder the interdisciplinary care of patients, especially at the end of life, and derive recommendations for action.

interventions.name: Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the files of patients who were placed in forensic psychiatric care pursuant to Section 63 of the German Criminal Code (StGB) and died while undergoing treatment

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1.    Placement pursuant to Section 63 of the German Criminal Code (StGB)
2.    Treatment and death in one of the above-mentioned clinics between January 1, 2015, and July 1, 2025
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete or inaccessible files

sites.f: 3 Kliniken in Trägerschaft des Landschaftsverbandes Rheinland (LVR): LVR-Kliniken Köln, Bedburg-Hau und Düren
